title: ConvBERT: wrong head_ratio produces view mismatch in mixed attention

title: Longformer: global attention view uses wrong dimension order

title: Diffusers UNet1DModel: GaussianFourier hardcoded embedding_size=8 mismatches TimestepEmbedding

description: GaussianFourierProjection(embedding_size=8) outputs 16 features, but TimestepEmbedding.linear_1=Linear(64, 128) expects 64. timestep_input_dim was computed as 2*block_out_channels[0]=64, mismatch with hardcoded embedding_size=8 giving output 16.
substitution_note: Default block_out_channels=(32,32,64); old code: GaussianFourier(embedding_size=8) -> 16 features; timestep_input_dim=2*32=64.
